statement: In texts not used for exploration, when a text ends in the jar sign followed by a man sign (G740 then G90, G91 or G125), the sign right before the jar is a fish-family sign more often than when a text ends in the jar sign alone.
basis: scouting on ICIT exploration split, 27 Oct 2026: ending G740 G90, fish right before jar 23/45 (51%); ending G740, 14/536 (3%). Neither the holdout nor the held-out-from-export set has been examined for this relation.
data: ICIT locked holdout (indus_website split 'holdout') plus the held-out-from-export set (icit_new_to_export), complete texts only (drop_damaged), deduplicated by sign sequence, any site. Exploration texts excluded.
fish_family: G220 and every sign the blind mark annotation (data/sign_marks/marks_blind_2026-10-20.csv) derives from base G220
groups: A = texts of 3+ signs whose last two signs are G740 then a man sign (G90, G91, G125); B = texts of 2+ signs whose last sign is G740
statistic: share of A texts with a fish-family sign right before the G740, minus the same share for B
test: one-sided Fisher exact test, alpha 0.05; also a 10,000-shuffle permutation of group labels with seed 20261027
min_support: at least 8 texts in A, else Inconclusive
